_doc: Signatures of the legacy (arb-lab) known-answer cases and the wallet transactions they need (PLAN WP-00b). Every `sig` here has a getTransaction fixture in testdata/wallet/<sig>.json (tools/capture-fixtures.py --wallet). `cases`: hand-picked ledger cases; `chain` is what the wallet transaction shows (fee the wallet paid, wallet lamport change, WSOL token change, other token changes, tip transfers, accounts created with their rent), `record` the v1 outcome line where one exists. `landed`: every landed wallet transaction of w5h-p1..p10 (res-pnl p1-p10), complete for the slot range. `wins_w5h2_w5h3`: every win of w5h2-p1..p11 and w5h3-p1..p2 (wallet-synthesis §2/§3). Amounts in lamports. Expected ledger lines and aggregates are in expected.json.

nonrecoverable_accounts.note: created by w5h-p6#69; PumpSwap user_volume_accumulator PDA seeded by the payer (inferred, res-pnl C2); not closable

cases.what: The transfer that created and funded the wallet with 4,349,000,000. Another account is the fee payer, so the wallet pays no fee.
Create and initialize one durable-nonce account (create only: 1,056,640 of recoverable rent; 20 such accounts lock 21,132,800).
Create the wallet's WSOL ATA and wrap 4,200,000,000 in one transaction (CreateIdempotent, System transfer, SyncNative).
cases.source: res-pnl C5 (WSOL ATA's own rent 1,488,440); chain

cases.what: A failed transaction paid by another signer that lists the wallet (InsufficientFundsForRent on another account). No wallet change.
cases.source: chain (getSignaturesForAddress of the wallet returns it)

cases.what: Landed failure (fee only): the p2 compete bid, cu_price 5,000,000, fee 1,305,030 of which priority 1,300,040, profit check 0x4e580002.
Landed failure the bot never recorded (statuses rate-limited); found only on chain. Fee 7,301.
Landed failure with a DLMM venue error (0x1794, bitmap extension not passed) instead of the profit check; no round trip recorded.
cases.source: res-pnl C9 (the one 0x1794 failure in p6)

cases.what: Bundle win that creates no account: residual 0, profit_lamports = round trip - fee - tip.
TPU win whose round trip (710) is below its fee (8,362): an ok route with negative trade net, no tip.
Bundle win that creates a 165-byte SPL token account left open (rent 1,488,440).
Bundle win that creates a 170-byte Token-2022 account (immutableOwner) left open (rent 1,513,840).
Bundle win that creates the PumpSwap user volume accumulator (1,346,200, owner pAMMBay6, 137 bytes; not recoverable) and leaves a Token-2022 account open (1,513,840).
cases.source: res-pnl C2 (residual -2,860,040); MEASUREMENT §4.42 golden example; PLAN WP-00b case 3

cases.what: The bolt trade: a direct (non-bundle) win of +27,459,627 (+28,973,467 before rent), tip 1,000,000 to bolt, creates a Token-2022 account.

landed.scope: every landed transaction of wallet 2g7rYv7y between the first and last landing of w5h-p1..p10
landed.how: recorded = outcomes.jsonl has the landing; recorded = false = a copy signature from attempts.jsonl found on chain (getSignaturesForAddress of the wallet) with no landed outcome. No other wallet transaction exists in the slot range. Re-check online with tools/capture-fixtures.py --discover.

wins_w5h2_w5h3.scope: every win (ok route transaction) of w5h2-p1..p11 and w5h3-p1..p2: 23 Jito-bundle wins and the bolt direct win
wins_w5h2_w5h3.how: from the chain ledger of that window (getSignaturesForAddress + getTransaction, wallet-synthesis §2), joined to attempts by signature
